Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!

Red Carpet Opening Night Event on Fri. 9/25
7:30 PM – Wine reception and a brief dance demonstration by DanceSway Ballroom
8:00 PM – Film screening
Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes,
Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an
infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

Lady

A new comedy starring Sian Clifford, directed by Samuel Abrahams.
While pursuing her artistic expression, Lady Isabella’s life takes a surreal
turn as she realizes if she’s not in the spotlight, she might just disappear.
View Trailer

The Scout

Film Followed by Q&A on Sun. 10/11 with director Paula Gonzalez-Nasser, moderated by Xander Robin.
A New York City location scout photographs the homes of strangers for a TV
pilot, stepping into their private lives while trying to satisfy her erratic employers.
